prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: worried the house is in a flood zone. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards younger members renting or buying their first home. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"Member was anxious that the property may sit in a flood zone after seeing local weather warnings; next time, check the latest flood map and keep the explanation simple and reassuring."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member responded best to a quick, plain-English update by message rather than a long call, and preferred clear next steps over technical detail."},{"type":"fact","content":"Member is still waiting for confirmation of whether the address falls within an area of flood risk, so the outcome of the flood-zone check remains open."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member mentioned this is their first home and they do not know what counts as flood risk, so future contact should avoid jargon and explain any terms used."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member liked being told what evidence would help next, especially photos of the outside of the property and any letters from the landlord or managing agent."},{"type":"fact","content":"Member has not reported any actual flooding at the property, and the current concern is only about perceived exposure to flood risk."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member became more settled when told that most claims are handled quickly unless there is recent water ingress, so next time reassure them early if no damage is reported."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member preferred a calm, supportive tone and asked not to be rushed; give them time to ask questions before closing the conversation."},{"type":"fact","content":"Open item is to confirm whether any nearby drainage, river, or surface-water issues have been raised in recent weather events for the area."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member is renting and wants to know whether the landlord is responsible for any flood-related building concerns, so future checks should include occupancy status and policy coverage scope."}]}
